title: generateElements
responsibility: Installs canonical HTML and SVG atoms in app or game projects while retaining a configured shared library and the existing design system.

inputs.name: generateElements.input
inputs.description: Optional root and force options; defaults to an empty object, root uses the current directory and omitted force preserves changed files.

outputs.name: generateElements
outputs.description: Promise of native-atom file-write statuses, or an empty write list naming an existing configured shared library; does not update SDK exports.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects non-app/game projects, invalid library configuration and refused overwrites using the existing CLI errors.

errors.name: Element generation failure
errors.description: Project detection, configured-library resolution and planned-file filesystem failures propagate without inventing successful writes.
